This endpoint is not available in Label Studio Community Edition. [Learn more about Label Studio Enterprise](https://humansignal.com/goenterprise)

Retrieve a list of all projects in a specific workspace.

response.name: Projects list

header.description:
(Required) The token (or API key) must be passed as a request header. You can find your user token on the User Account page in Label Studio. Example: 
curl https://label-studio-host/api/projects -H "Authorization: Token [your-token]"

description.content:
This endpoint is not available in Label Studio Community Edition. [Learn more about Label Studio Enterprise](https://humansignal.com/goenterprise)

Add a project to a specific workspace.

header.description:
(Required) The token (or API key) must be passed as a request header. You can find your user token on the User Account page in Label Studio. Example: 
curl https://label-studio-host/api/projects -H "Authorization: Token [your-token]"

description.content:
This endpoint is not available in Label Studio Community Edition. [Learn more about Label Studio Enterprise](https://humansignal.com/goenterprise)

Remove a project from a specific workspace. Pass the project ID via the `project` query parameter. For backward compatibility, a JSON body with `project` is still accepted.

query.description: Project ID to remove from the workspace.

header.description:
(Required) The token (or API key) must be passed as a request header. You can find your user token on the User Account page in Label Studio. Example: 
curl https://label-studio-host/api/projects -H "Authorization: Token [your-token]"
